User Guide

Introduction

Welcome to the Car Health Check application.

The application allows users to monitor vehicle health, review alerts, and generate reports.

Login

Steps

  1. Open the application URL.

  2. Enter username.

  3. Enter password.

  4. Click Login.

Dashboard

The dashboard displays:

  • Overall Health Score

  • Active Alerts

  • Service Recommendations

  • Recent Diagnostics

Example:

Vehicle Health Score: 92%
Active Alerts: 1
Last Inspection: 12-Oct-2026

Search Vehicle

Search by VIN

  1. Navigate to Vehicle Search.

  2. Enter VIN.

  3. Click Search.

Example:

VIN: WDB123456789XYZ

Vehicle Details

The following information is displayed:

  • Vehicle Model

  • Vehicle Status

  • Mileage

  • Last Service Date

  • Active Issues

Alert Management

The application generates alerts for:

  • High Engine Temperature

  • Low Battery Health

  • Low Tire Pressure

  • Sensor Malfunction

Alert Severity

Severity

Description

Critical

Immediate Attention Required

Major

Must Be Investigated

Minor

Informational Warning

Reports

Available reports:

Vehicle Health Report

Provides:

  • Overall Status

  • Failed Checks

  • Recommendations

Fleet Report

Provides:

  • Fleet Summary

  • Vehicle Ranking

  • Open Issues

Notifications

Notifications can be received through:

  • Email

  • SMS

  • In-App Alerts

Frequently Asked Questions

How often is the health score updated?

Every 15 minutes.

Can I export reports?

Yes. Reports can be exported as PDF.

Who can configure thresholds?

Only Administrators.

Logout

  1. Click the profile icon.

  2. Select Logout.

You will be redirected to the login page.
